test_title: PYST 3: SSC CPO - English (Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Face the music

options.text: To work every possible way to succeed
To accept punishment for some mistake which you have done
To be cheated by someone you trust
To have the problems with money

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2** i.e. **To accept punishment for some mistake which you have done**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Face the music"** means to confront the unpleasant consequences of one's actions, or **to accept punishment for some mistake** for wrongdoings (आपकी गलतियों के लिए सजा स्वीकार करना).
 
• Example: After making a serious error in the financial report, he knew he had to face the music and explain himself to his boss.

Therefore, the correct answer is- **To accept punishment for some mistake which you have done.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• To work every possible way to succeed (सफल होने के लिए हर संभव तरीके से काम करना) means to put in effort from all possible angles to achieve success.
 
• To be cheated by someone you trust (जिस पर आप भरोसा करते हैं, उसके द्वारा धोखा खाना) indicates being deceived or betrayed by someone whom you considered reliable or trustworthy.
 
• To have problems with money (पैसे के साथ समस्याएं होना) means to face financial difficulties or issues regarding money management.
